messages.tip.action_button: Runs this action using 当前 data 和 parameter 值.
messages.tip.angle: 最小 angular separation, in degrees, between accepted density maxima. Larger values keep fewer, more widely separated 主 poles; smaller values may retain nearby peaks from the same orientation 组.
messages.tip.bins: Sets KDE 密度-grid level as 2^N cells per axis. Higher 值 reveal finer 密度 detail but require 更多 memory 和 computation. Use lowest 值 that resolves stable 密度 maxima.
messages.tip.classify_action: Assigns each point to the closest reviewed 主 pole within the JS cone threshold and writes the JS 标量场. The reviewed pole table, not the original automatic peaks, is used.
messages.tip.colour.dof: 选择 number 的 rotation 度 的 freedom. Use 2 用于 original two-角度 rotation model 或 3 用于 intrinsic Z-Y-X Euler rotation used 按 three-degree-的-freedom model.
messages.tip.colour.objective: 选择 目标函数 minimised during optimisation. It controls how rotated pole orientations are penalised 或 distributed 在 colour reference system.
messages.tip.colour.subsample: Percentage of valid point 法向量 used during optimisation. Lower percentages reduce computation time; 100% uses all valid 法向量.
messages.tip.colour.iterations: 最大 number of differential-evolution generations. Higher values allow a more extensive search but increase computation time.
messages.tip.colour.population: Population multiplier used 按 differential evolution. Larger 值 evaluate 更多 candidate rotations per generation, increasing search effort 和 computation 时间.
messages.tip.colour.seed: Optional integer 随机种子. 输入 a 值 到 make sampling 和 optimisation reproducible; leave blank 到 use a new 随机种子.
messages.tip.colour.export_copy: Creates a new CloudCompare 点云 coloured using the selected colour space and the selected pole space. The original 点云 is not modified.
messages.tip.colour.show_density: Displays relative pole-密度 distribution obtained 使用 optimised rotation. It does not run optimisation again.
messages.tip.colour.show_poles: Displays the point-法向量 poles after applying the optimised rotation, using the selected stereonet projection.
messages.tip.clouds: When 面片 are created, also creates one separate 点云 for each 最终 聚类. Disable this for very large datasets if the additional clouds use too much memory.
messages.tip.cluster: Runs DBSCAN independently within each positive JS 组, estimates a 组-specific eps, removes components smaller than ppcluster, fits 平面 equations, and writes cl, A, B, C, D and sigma using the original global point indices.
messages.tip.colour.optimise: Starts the 法向量-colour optimisation with the parameters entered above and determines the rotation angles that minimise the selected objective function.
messages.tip.dbscanminpts: 最小 number of points inside the DBSCAN neighbourhood, including the point itself, required for a core point. The MATLAB method uses 4. Increasing this value requires denser neighbourhoods and may classify more points as noise.
messages.tip.clustering_method: 选择空间聚类算法。DBSCAN 使用 K、k_sigma 和 MinPts；HDBSCAN 使用 Min Samples 和 Cluster Selection。
messages.tip.hdbscan_min_samples: HDBSCAN 密度参数。它在数学上不等同于 DBSCAN MinPts；scikit-learn 的 HDBSCAN 会将点本身计入。
messages.tip.cluster_selection: EOM 选择持久簇；Leaf 从层次结构中选择更细粒度的簇。
messages.tip.density_action: Calculates the KDE pole-density surface and extracts automatic 主 poles. Review and, if necessary, edit the resulting pole table before assigning JS 组.
messages.tip.editable_param: Editable parameter. 输入 a numeric 值 where appropriate; associated label indicates units 和 parameter effect.
messages.tip.facets: Creates one convex planar mesh for each valid 最终 聚类 using its stored global point indices and fitted 平面. Clustering must be completed first.
messages.tip.family_clouds: After clustering, creates one 点云 for each positive JS 组. Each 点云 contains that 组’s points and retains the JS, cl and 平面 标量场.
messages.tip.family_plot_action: Plots point 法向量 coloured by their current JS value and overlays the reviewed 主 poles. This is available only when JS corresponds to the current reviewed pole table.
messages.tip.fix: When selected, each 聚类 in a JS 组 uses the reviewed 组-pole 法向量 and derives only D from the 聚类 centroid. When cleared, each 聚类 法向量 is fitted locally using PCA/SVD.
messages.tip.jscone: 最大 angular difference, in degrees, between a point 法向量 and a reviewed 主 pole. The closest pole inside this cone defines JS; points outside all cones receive JS=0.
messages.tip.kneighbor: Neighbour order used to estimate eps separately for each JS 组. The MATLAB method uses K=4 and queries K+1 neighbours because the first result is the point itself. Larger K represents a broader local spacing scale.
messages.tip.ksigma: Multiplier in eps = mean(unique KNN distances) + k_sigma × sample standard deviation. The MATLAB method uses 2. Larger values increase eps and tend to join components across wider gaps; smaller values tend to split 聚类.
messages.tip.labels: Shows cardinal directions, angular guides 和 stereonet annotations. These guides are visual only 和 do not affect calculations.
messages.tip.maxpoles: 最大 number of automatic 主 poles retained from the density surface. It limits the candidate JS 组; the reviewed pole table remains authoritative and can be edited manually.
messages.tip.merge: Coplanarity threshold based on |Di-Dj|/(sigma_i+sigma_j). Larger values merge more same-组 聚类 into a common 平面; smaller values preserve more separate 平面. Set 0 to disable this merge.
messages.tip.minclustersize: 最小 component size after DBSCAN, corresponding to MATLAB ppcluster. Components with fewer points are rejected and assigned cl=0. This does not control whether a point is a DBSCAN core point.
messages.tip.plot_poles: Plots all valid point 法向量 as poles on the selected stereonet projection. This is a visual inspection step and does not modify the 点云.
messages.tip.pole_add: Adds a new 主 pole from the 倾向 and 倾角 values. The table and density plot update immediately; 组 IDs are renumbered and existing JS and 聚类 results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_apply: Applies the 倾向 and 倾角 values to the selected 主 pole. The reviewed table becomes the source of truth, so JS classification and clustering must then be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_delete: Deletes the selected 主 pole, renumbers the remaining 组 and refreshes the plot. Existing JS and 聚类 results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_down: Moves the selected pole one row down. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes 组 IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_move: Changes the 组 order. Because 组 IDs follow table order, changing the order requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_table: Authoritative reviewed list of 主 poles. JS classification, 组 plots, Fisher K and subsequent clustering use this exact order and orientation. Editing or reordering the table invalidates existing JS and 聚类 results.
messages.tip.pole_up: Moves the selected pole one row up. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes 组 IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.poles.source: Choose whether pole plots, density and automatic peak detection use the original 法向量 or 法向量 transformed by the optimised rotation. Stored 主-pole orientations always remain in the original reference system.
messages.tip.projection: Selects the stereographic projection used for plots. 等角 preserves angular relationships; equal-area preserves area. This setting changes only the visual projection, not the original point 法向量 or 标量场.
messages.tip.refresh: Refreshes the selected CloudCompare entity and checks which workflow actions and 工具 commands have the data required to run.
messages.tip.seed: Optional integer used only with 随机 聚类 ordering. The same seed reproduces the numbering; leave blank to generate a new random order for each run.
messages.tip.show_density: Displays the last computed density and current 主 poles without recalculating the KDE or detecting peaks.
messages.tip.sort: Controls 最终 cl numbering within each JS 组. Size orders the largest 聚类 first, D follows their spatial position along the fitted 法向量, and 随机 shuffles the order. IDs restart at 1 for each 组.
messages.tip.style: Chooses line contours 或 filled contours 用于 密度 plot. This changes visualisation only; 密度 值 和 detected 极点 are not recalculated.

messages.tip.export_hsv: Exports a new 点云 coloured with the selected colour space and calculated in the selected pole space (原始 or 旋转后).
messages.gui.export_hsv_requires_normals: Select a 点云 with computed 法向量 first.
messages.gui.export_hsv_no_rotation: A rotated 极点空间 is not 可用 because no colour optimisation has been 已完成.

messages.colour.error.lightness_range: 值 / lightness 必须为 between 0 和 100.
messages.tip.colour.space: Select the cylindrical colour space used to convert the rotated 法向量 orientation into RGB colours for the 点云.
messages.tip.colour.lightness: Sets 值/lightness parameter 从 0 到 100 用于 已选择 颜色空间. Higher 值 generally produce lighter colours.
messages.tip.spectral_clustering: 打开谱聚类工具（Jimenez-Rodriguez & Sitar，2006），将极点分组为不连续面组并在赤平投影图上显示。
messages.tip.spectral.sigma: 极点之间亲和度的尺度。较小值（0.10）会更严格地分离各组，也可能将一组拆为两组；较大值（0.15）会合并相近极点。论文建议使用 0.10-0.15；默认值为 0.12。如果一组被拆开，请增大此值；如果两组合并，请减小此值。
messages.tip.spectral.k: 要查找的不连续面组数。根据密度图输入预期数量（例如 3 或 4），也可留空以使用下方方法自动选择。
messages.tip.spectral.method: 仅在 K 为空时使用。'eigengap' 选择相邻特征值之间最大跃变对应的 K（速度快）。'silhouette' 会尝试最大值以内的所有 K，并保留分离效果最佳的划分（速度较慢，但通常对含噪数据更稳健）。
messages.tip.spectral.kmax: 自动选择时考虑的最大组数（最小为 2）。典型岩质边坡有 3 到 6 组；8 是稳妥的上限。
messages.tip.spectral.samples: 该方法构建 N x N 矩阵，因此内存和耗时随 N 的平方增长。如果极点数超过此值，会随机抽取该数量的极点（均匀抽样、不重复，使用固定种子以保证结果可复现）来查找各组，剩余极点会分配给最近的组质心。如果极点较少，则使用全部极点。通常 2000-4000 已足够；更大的值会更慢且需要更多内存。
messages.tip.spectral.status: 上次运行摘要：组数 K、sigma、silhouette 分数（越接近 1 表示分组越清晰）、使用的极点数及极点空间。
messages.tip.spectral.table: 各组在原始空间中的平均方向：极点数量和百分比、平面的倾向/倾角，以及其极点的趋势/俯伏角。
messages.tip.tools.colour_optimisation: 查找极点空间的旋转方式，以优化法线的颜色表示。
messages.tip.tools.normal_spacing: 根据聚类平面计算各不连续面族的法线间距。
messages.tip.tools.persistence: 根据聚类平面估算各不连续面族的持久性。
messages.tip.tools.report: 生成技术报告（HTML/Markdown），包含本次会话中所有分析的参数、方法、图表和结果。
messages.report.title: 技术报告
messages.report.author: 作者
messages.report.outdated_hint: 仅包含与当前主极点一致的结果。如果编辑极点或重新运行步骤 1，请重新执行后续步骤以将其纳入报告。
messages.report.no_results: 暂无可报告的结果。请先运行至少一项分析（颜色优化、步骤 1 等）。
messages.tip.spectral.space: 分析所用的极点空间。'原始空间' 使用测得的法线（赤平投影图显示罗盘方位标签）。'旋转空间' 使用颜色优化旋转后的极点（仅在运行颜色优化后可用；赤平投影图不显示标签）。表格中的质心方向始终使用原始空间表示。
messages.tip.spectral.legend: 显示或隐藏赤平投影图上的图例；图例可能遮挡部分数据。
messages.tip.spectral.legend_orient: 选中后，图例还会列出每个质心的倾向/倾角（原始空间）。取消选中可缩短图例并减少对图表的遮挡。
messages.tip.spectral.calculate: 使用这些参数运行谱聚类，并在赤平投影图上绘制结果。将光标移至图表可读取倾向和倾角。
messages.about.body:
Authors:
  Adrián Riquelme Guill
  Roberto Tomás Jover
  Antonio Abellán Fernández
  University of Alicante

Scientific references:
  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., Tomas, R., & Jaboyedoff, M. (2014).
  A new approach for semi-automatic rock mass joints recognition
  from 3D point clouds. Computers & Geosciences, 68, 38-52.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cageo.2014.03.014

  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., & Tomas, R. (2015).
  Discontinuity spacing analysis in rock masses using 3D point clouds.
  Engineering Geology, 195, 185-195.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.enggeo.2015.06.009

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2018).
  Automatic mapping of discontinuity persistence on rock masses using
  3D point clouds. Rock Mechanics and Rock Engineering, 51, 3005-3028.
  https://doi.org/10.1007/s00603-018-1519-9

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2026).
  Orientation-based colour mapping and spherical density analysis for
  rock discontinuity detection in 3D point clouds of roadcut slopes.
  Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jrmge.2025.12.059

  Riquelme Guill, A. (2015).
  Uso de nubes de puntos 3D para identificación y caracterización de
  familias de discontinuidades planas en afloramientos rocosos y
  evaluación de la calidad geomecánica. Doctoral thesis, University of
  Alicante.
  https://rua.ua.es/entities/publication/78d254b9-1a7b-49b1-a35a-c0edbdeeb225

Based on:
  Adrian Riquelme's MATLAB implementation of the Discontinuity Set
  Extractor (DSE), Department of Civil Engineering, University of
  Alicante, Spain.

Libraries and algorithms:
  - NumPy: numerical arrays and vector operations.
  - SciPy: KDE, differential evolution, nearest-neighbour queries,
    connected components and convex-hull geometry.
  - Matplotlib: stereonet, density and analysis plotting.
  - colorcet: scientific and perceptually useful colour maps used by
    the 聚类 visualisation.
  - Pillow: icon loading, resizing and GUI icon normalisation.
  - CloudCompare / pycc: 点云, 法向量 and scalar-field access.
  - Tkinter / ttk: graphical user interface.
  - PyVista (optional): interactive 3D 法向量/sphere visualisation.

  Algorithms and methods:
  - DSE 主-pole extraction using spherical/steronet KDE, based on
    the Botev et al. kernel-density approach.
  - Differential Evolution for 法向量-colour rotation optimisation.
  - DBSCAN (Ester et al., 1996) for spatial clustering of discontinuity
    组.
  - Fisher directional statistics for mean-pole concentration and
    confidence intervals.
  - cKDTree nearest-neighbour searches and Qhull convex-hull geometry
    through SciPy.

Acknowledgments:
  CloudCompare development team and the researchers whose methods
  underpin the DSE workflow.
messages.colour.angles_unit_note: Rotation angles are expressed in degrees (°). Edit the values and press 应用 angles to use them manually.
messages.colour.error.invalid_angles: 旋转 angles 必须为 finite numeric 值.
messages.log.colour.manual_angles: 已应用手动颜色旋转：角度=[{angles}]，目标函数={value:.6g}。
messages.tip.colour.rotation_angle: 旋转 角度 在 度. For 3 度 的 freedom these 字段 are intrinsic Z-Y-X Euler angles: Z (yaw), Y (pitch) 和 X (roll). For 2 度 的 freedom only 首先 two angles are used.
messages.gui.normal_spacing_save_error: Could not save the 法向量 spacing results: {error}
messages.gui.spacing_family: 组 to analyse. Select 全部 to calculate the 法向量 spacing for every available discontinuity set.
messages.gui.spacing_bandwidth: KDE bandwidth for the 法向量-spacing distribution. Enter 0 to select the bandwidth automatically.
messages.gui.spacing_minimum: 最小 法向量 spacing retained in the analysis. Values at or below this threshold are filtered out before calculating the density curves.
messages.gui.spacing_dtolerance: Tolerance used to group 聚类 平面 with the same fitted D value. Smaller values require closer D values to be considered the same 平面.
messages.gui.persistence_family: 组 to analyse. Select 全部 to calculate persistence for every available discontinuity set.
messages.gui.persistence_dtolerance: Tolerance used to group 聚类 with the same fitted D value into a single 平面 before persistence is calculated.
messages.gui.persistence_export: Also save 延续性 tables 和 figures 到 已选择 folder.
